name: Multivitamin Toothpaste 5+ (80g)
subtitle: Developed by dentists with fluoride

benefits.title: Strengthens Teeth
benefits.description: Vitamin D3 plays a crucial role in calcium absorption, which is essential for strong teeth.

benefits.title: Protects Gums
benefits.description: Vitamin E acts like a shield, protecting gum cells from harm and helping the body fight infections to keep gums healthy. It also helps repair damaged gum tissues, making gums stronger and healthier.

benefits.title: Healthy Oral Health
benefits.description: Vitamin B-12 is an essential vitamin that plays a significant role in the formation and maintenance of your teeth and gums

benefits.title: Fights Bacteria
benefits.description: Neem oil helps teeth and gums by fighting bacteria that cause plaque and gum disease, keeping breath fresh and supporting overall oral health. Just a small amount can make a big difference, but it's best to check with a dentist before using it regularly.

benefits.title: Freshens Breath
benefits.description: Aloe vera helps teeth and gums by reducing inflammation, fighting bacteria, and soothing gum irritation, promoting healthier gums and fresher breath.

ingredients.name: Aloe Vera
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Aloe vera helps in keeping gum diseases, infections, and oral cavities away. It also soothes kid’s teeth.

ingredients.name: Neem Oil
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Neem Oil prevents tooth decay, oral infections, prevents bleeding and sore gums. It also prevents cavities and gum disease.

ingredients.name: Triphala
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Triphala has proven to significantly decrease plaque and boost oral hygiene.

ingredients.name: Pomegranate
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: The antibacterial qualities in the pomegranates serve to fight dental plaque. It lowers the chances of developing tooth decay and gum disease.

fullIngredientsList: Sorbitol, Silica,Glycerine, Lauryl Glucoside, Xylitol, Aqua, Vitamin-E, Dicalcium Phosphate, Stevia, Sodium Carboxymethyl Cellulose, Sodium Fluoride, Pyridoxine HCl, Calcium Pantothenate, Aloe Vera W/S Extract, Pomegranate W/S Extract, Triphala W/S Extract,Vitamin D3, Neem Oil, Flavour,Colour CI No. 14720 & 19140.

faqs.question: How do we use the Strawberry Toothpaste?
faqs.answer: Use a pea-sized amount of toothpaste & gently brush gums & teeth in a circular motion. Rinse, gargle & giggle.

faqs.question: Is it safe for children?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our toothpaste is fluoride free and doesn't have any side effects.

faqs.question: Is it safe if my child accidenly swallows the toothpaste?
faqs.answer: Yes! It is safe if swallowed.
